Entry.JapaneseText: ワンダーシェフ
Entry.EnglishText: Wonder Chef

Entry.JapaneseText: ミリー
Entry.EnglishText: Milly

Entry.JapaneseText: ジョン
Entry.EnglishText: John

Entry.JapaneseText: ステキな師範代
Entry.EnglishText: Charismatic Instructor

Entry.JapaneseText: トーティス遊撃隊隊員
Entry.EnglishText: Task Force Member

Entry.JapaneseText: 活発な少年
Entry.EnglishText: Lively Boy

Entry.JapaneseText: グリッド
Entry.EnglishText: Grid

Entry.JapaneseText: 好奇心旺盛な少女
Entry.EnglishText: Extremely Curious Girl

Entry.JapaneseText: 空腹の少年
Entry.EnglishText: Hungry Boy

Entry.JapaneseText: 見つけてくれて サンキュー！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you found me! Thank you~!

Entry.JapaneseText: ご褒美よ！
Entry.EnglishText: Here, a reward!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……では、サラバっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: ...And with that... Farewell!

Entry.JapaneseText: お兄ちゃんたち、 黒精石持ってる～？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, bro's friends, do you have a Black Spirit Gem~?

Entry.JapaneseText: 持ってたら、ちょうだい
Entry.EnglishText: If you have one, can I have it?

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へった～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hungry~

Entry.JapaneseText: ケチー！
Entry.EnglishText: So stingy!

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へった～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hungry~

Entry.JapaneseText: やったー、ありがと
Entry.EnglishText: Yaaay, thanks.

Entry.JapaneseText: グリッド兄ちゃん、 黒精石、手に入れたよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Grid, I got the Black Spirit Gem!

Entry.JapaneseText: ケチー！
Entry.EnglishText: So stingy!

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へった～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hungry~

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの主は ヴァルハラへ行ったよ？
Entry.EnglishText: The young master went to the Valhalla Plains, you know?
Entry.Notes: Need to double check if this is actually what is being said; seems weird that it's posed as a question. - maxle it uses a question mark because he's unsure why you're talking to him - nanashi

Entry.JapaneseText: トーティス遊撃隊の隊長にして ユークリッド独立騎士団の 顧問だからね
Entry.EnglishText: He is, after all, both the commander of the Totus Mobile Task Force and a consultant to the Euclid Liberation Knights.
Entry.Notes: Check on the terminology and make sure it's consistent.

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの主の名前は <Cless>・アルベイン
Entry.EnglishText: The young master's name is <Cless> Alvein.

Entry.JapaneseText: ダオスを倒した鋭い アルベイン流剣術の使い手だ
Entry.EnglishText: He's the man who defeated Dhaos, and a fierce practitioner of the Alvein Style Sword Artes.

Entry.JapaneseText: 強いだけではない、 優しい心の持ち主でもあるのだ
Entry.EnglishText: And he isn't just strong. He possesses a kind heart, as well.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私は我が主<Cless>の次に この道場で偉い師範代だ
Entry.EnglishText: I am an assistant instructor, and the second most distinguished person at this dojo—after our master, <Cless>.
Entry.Notes: Should we go with Sensei, Master, or something else?

Entry.JapaneseText: と言っても、 <Cless>様に比べると 剣の腕はまだまだだが
Entry.EnglishText: That said, if you were to compare me to Master <Cless>, my skill with the sword would come up very short.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今は<Cless>様が留守中なので 私が代わりにこの道場の 指導を請け負っている
Entry.EnglishText: Since <Cless> is currently away, I have taken over instruction duties in his stead.

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし私もまだまだ修行不足だな。 <Cless>様がいないと 道場生もすっかりダレてしまう
Entry.EnglishText: However, my own training is sorely lacking. Without <Cless> here, the dojo's students have lost all interest.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Cless>様がようやく 帰ってきてくださった というのにまたお出かけになるらしい
Entry.EnglishText: Master <Cless> finally returned to us, but it seems he'll be leaving again in short order.

Entry.JapaneseText: 早くこの作戦が終わり、 びしびしと道場生に 指導してほしいものだ
Entry.EnglishText: I hope this military operation concludes soon, so he can engage the students with his usual relentless instruction.

Entry.JapaneseText: トーティス遊撃隊が活躍すれば また入門志願者が増えるだろう
Entry.EnglishText: If the Totus Mobile Task Force does well, we should see yet another increase in dojo applicants.

Entry.JapaneseText: アルベイン流がもっと広く 世間に認知されるといいな
Entry.EnglishText: It would be nice if the Alvein Style could be recognized far and wide.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私は我が主<Cless>の次に この道場で偉い師範代だ
Entry.EnglishText: I am an assistant instructor, and the second most distinguished person at this dojo—after our master, <Cless>.
Entry.Notes: Should we go with Sensei, Master, or something else?

Entry.JapaneseText: と言っても、 <Cless>様に比べると 剣の腕はまだまだだが
Entry.EnglishText: That said, if you were to compare me to Master <Cless>, my skill with the sword would come up very short.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今は<Cless>が留守中なので 私が代わりにこの道場の 指導を請け負っている
Entry.EnglishText: Since <Cless> is currently away, I have taken over instruction duties in his stead.

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、私もまだまだ修行不足だ。 <Cless>様がいないと 道場生もすっかりダレてしまう
Entry.EnglishText: But I've still got a lot ot learn. Without <Cless>, the dojo students lose all motivation and start slacking.

Entry.JapaneseText: ヴァルハラでの 軍事行動も無事終わった
Entry.EnglishText: The military operation in Valhalla has concluded successfully.

Entry.JapaneseText: しばらく、<Cless>様も道場に 落ち着いてくださるだろう
Entry.EnglishText: I imagine Master <Cless> will be able to settle in with us at the dojo for a time.
Entry.Notes: I do think I need a bit investigating to see the tone

Entry.JapaneseText: ここでもっと 弟子たちの腕を がんがん磨いてもらいたいものだ
Entry.EnglishText: I'd like for him to help our pupils polish their sword skills some more, with his usual vigor.

Entry.JapaneseText: そして道場破りが来ても 安心できるように！
Entry.EnglishText: That way, even should a challenger arrive at our dojo's door, we'll have nothing to worry about!
Entry.Notes: Need to confirm if this takes place after the previous line.

Entry.JapaneseText: いつ襲い来るかわからない 外敵からこの村を守るため トーティス遊撃隊は作られた
Entry.EnglishText: The Totus Mobile Task Forced was created so that we may protect the village from the assaults of any unexpected invaders.

Entry.JapaneseText: ２度とあんな悲劇を繰り返さない、 遊撃隊にはそんな強い<Cless>様の 想いが込められているのだ
Entry.EnglishText: Master <Cless>'s fervent and earnest desire to avoid a repeat of that terrible tragedy is at the heart of the Mobile Task Force.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Cless>様が存分に トーティス遊撃隊で その腕を振るえるように
Entry.EnglishText: I wish for Master <Cless> to be able to exercise his full ability as leader of the Totus Mobile Task Force.
Entry.Notes: Wondering if we should rearrange the words for this and the following line so it flows better. The way it's structured doesn't sound very good in English.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私はこの道場を しっかり守っていこうと そう思うのだ
Entry.EnglishText: And to ensure that he can, I will devote all that I have to watching over this dojo.

Entry.JapaneseText: 前の騎士団襲撃の時に家を 焼け出されて<Chester>さんは、 うちの道場に住んでいる
Entry.EnglishText: <Chester>, having been forced from his home when it was burned down in the Knights' assault, now lives in our dojo.

Entry.JapaneseText: まったく<Cless>さん、 友達想いなんだから
Entry.EnglishText: Man, <Cless> is just too good to his friends.
Entry.Notes: Is this talking to Cless directly? Need to confirm.

Entry.JapaneseText: 道場にいる子どもたちは <Chester>さんが拾ってきた 子どもたちだ
Entry.EnglishText: The children at the dojo were taken in by <Chester>.

Entry.JapaneseText: みんな親がなくて困ってたんだと
Entry.EnglishText: He said they don't have any parents, so they've had it rough.

Entry.JapaneseText: さすが <Cless>さんの友達、 お優しいことだ
Entry.EnglishText: That kindness is just what you'd expect from a friend of <Cless>.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Chester>さんが留守の時は 私が子どもたちの面倒を 見ているんだ
Entry.EnglishText: When <Chester> is away, I'm the one who looks after the kids.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あいつらナマイキで 困るよ……
Entry.EnglishText: ...They're cheeky brats, and are always causing trouble...

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、カワイイ……♪
Entry.EnglishText: But, they're still cute... ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: まったくあの子どもたちには 手を焼かされるよ
Entry.EnglishText: Those kids are just such a darn handful.

Entry.JapaneseText: ま、それもまた 楽しいんだけどね
Entry.EnglishText: But, y'know... I do enjoy that, too, in its own way.

Entry.JapaneseText: 一応ボクはトーティス遊撃隊の 補欠隊員なんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Technically, I'm a fallback member of the Totus Mobile Task Force.

Entry.JapaneseText: 正隊員になるまでは 拠点であるこの道場で 後方支援するのがお仕事だ
Entry.EnglishText: But until I become a proper member, my job is to provide logistical support from our base—this dojo.

Entry.JapaneseText: まだちゃんとお仕事を できないボクだけど、
Entry.EnglishText: Right now, I'm still not too great at the job, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: いつかこの村のために 働きたいと思っているんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I truly feel that, someday, I'd like my work to help everyone in the village.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだよ、おまえ！！ 勝手に入ってくんな！
Entry.EnglishText: The hell's your problem!? Don't just barge in here!

Entry.JapaneseText: 子どもがこんなとこに 何の用事だよ！
Entry.EnglishText: What's business's some kid like you got being here!?

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは オレたちの家だぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: This is *our* house!

Entry.JapaneseText: 勝手に入ってきたら カタク、シンニウザイで 訴えるぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: Barge in like this and I'll take you to court, for tress-pass-ing on our pry-vet property!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだよ、おまえ！ 何の用だよ！
Entry.EnglishText: The hell's your problem? You here on some kinda business!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 何も用がないなら 話しかけるな！
Entry.EnglishText: If you don't got any business here, then don't friggin' talk to me!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Chester>兄ちゃんに メーワクかけたら オレが承知しないからな！
Entry.EnglishText: Make yourself a new-sense for my big bro <Chester> and you'll be answering to me! You got that!?
Entry.Notes: How should we say "<Chester>兄ちゃんに"?

Entry.JapaneseText: 感謝しろよな！ <Chester>兄ちゃんに！
Entry.EnglishText: You better be real grateful to my bro!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんとかなんとかを 取ってきてくれたんだぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: He fetched that... whatchamacallit for you!

Entry.JapaneseText: 兄ちゃんにメーワクばっかかけやがって！
Entry.EnglishText: You're always such a new-sense for my big bro!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Chester>兄ちゃんは 忙しいんだかんな！
Entry.EnglishText: <Chester>'s busy, you got that!?

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだよ！ また来たのかよ！ さっさと帰れよ！！
Entry.EnglishText: The hell!? You're back here *again*!? Go back to wherever the hell you came from! ...*Now*!

Entry.JapaneseText: な、なんだよ、 もう、帰るの、かよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Th-The hell...? You're...leaving already...?
Entry.Notes: Should I use "Aww" or "What the heck" or something else?

Entry.JapaneseText: な、なんでもないよ！ いいよ！ さ、さっさと帰れ、よ……！
Entry.EnglishText: I-I didn't say nothing! It's fine! J-Just get out of here, already...!

Entry.JapaneseText: お兄ちゃんたち ダレ～？ ダレ～？
Entry.EnglishText: Ehhh? Who are you guys~? Who~?
Entry.Notes: Need to rephrase it to make it sound more natural.

Entry.JapaneseText: お金集めの人？ お金はないよ～？
Entry.EnglishText: Are you here for donations? I'm flat broke, you know~?

Entry.JapaneseText: 知らない人が来たら 話しちゃダメだって～
Entry.EnglishText: I was told not to talk to strangers~

Entry.JapaneseText: あぁ、話しちゃったね～
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, but I just talked to you, didn't I~

Entry.JapaneseText: あ、また話しちゃった～、あ……
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, I talked again~ Ahh...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Chester>兄ちゃん、 やさしいよ～
Entry.EnglishText: Big bro <Chester>'s so kind~

Entry.JapaneseText: おりょーりも じょうずなんだよ～
Entry.EnglishText: And he's talon-ted at cook-ing, too~

Entry.JapaneseText: おっきくなったらミリー、 <Chester>兄ちゃんの およめさんなの
Entry.EnglishText: When I grow up, I'm gonna be <Chester>'s wife!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Chester>兄ちゃん 大好きなの～
Entry.EnglishText: I love my big bro soooo much~

Entry.JapaneseText: おかえり～、ただいま～♪
Entry.EnglishText: Welcome home~ I'm home~

Entry.JapaneseText: いってらっしゃい～ いってきま～す♪
Entry.EnglishText: Stay safe~ I'll be back so~on ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: ごあいさつのれんしゅう☆
Entry.EnglishText: I'm prack-tiss-ing my greet-ings. ☆

Entry.JapaneseText: お兄ちゃんたち <Chester>兄ちゃんと おともだち～？
Entry.EnglishText: Are you guys friends with my big bro~?

Entry.JapaneseText: だったら、ミリーとも おともだち～
Entry.EnglishText: If you are, then Milly will be your friend, too~

Entry.JapaneseText: <Chester>兄ちゃんが いなくても ミリーさみちくないよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Even when <Chester>'s not here, Milly doesn't feel lonely, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: だって、グリッド兄ちゃんとジョンが いるもん
Entry.EnglishText: 'Cause I still have Grid and John here with me!

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、好きなのは <Chester>兄ちゃん！
Entry.EnglishText: But, big bro's still the one I love the most!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Cless>兄ちゃんよりも 好きーー∀
Entry.EnglishText: I love him waaay more than even <Cless>~ ∀

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へった～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hungry~

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へったよ～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm so hungry~
I'm hungry~ *growl*

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へったよ～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm so hungry~

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へった～へった～ 肉食いたい……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hungry~, huungryy~ I wanna eat steak...

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へった～ カレー食いたい……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hungry~ I wanna eat curry...

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へった～ やせる～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hungry~ I'm gonna get skinny~

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へった～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hungry~

Entry.JapaneseText: さっき食った～
Entry.EnglishText: I just ate~

Entry.JapaneseText: でも腹へった～
Entry.EnglishText: But I'm hungry~

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹へった～ なんでもいいから 食いたい～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hungry~ Gimmie anything, I just wanna eat~
